messages:
Sam: Heads up — since ~09:12 UTC we're seeing a small spike of 503s from the hosted inference gateway. Error pattern looks like upstream worker crashes (segfault / GPU OOM) for a subset of requests. Example req id: req_0a3f. Logs show `terminate: signal 11` and NVML OOM.
ops-bot: Alert created INC-2026 — page sent to oncall.
Jess: I can confirm from SRE dashboards — failures concentrated in pool-east-1, about 12% error rate on that pool. p95 latency up ~300ms. Pods show frequent restarts (restartCount++ on a few workers).
Mike: Noted. Any commonality in payloads? Could be packing/batching edge case. Do we have a minimal repro payload?
Sam: Quick sanitized repro payload (we've been able to trigger locally sometimes):
```json
{"model":"redwood-short","requests":[{"context_ids":[1,0,0,5,0,...],"tokens":512},{"context_ids":[],"tokens":1024}]}
```
When we send ~6 concurrent mixed-size batches (small+large contexts) with dynamic packing it reliably spikes GPU mem then crashes.
Tara: Stack trace from worker node-3 attached to logs: `nvml:out_of_memory` followed by `SIGSEGV` in attention kernel (kernel idx: attn_v2.cu:742). GPU mem goes to 99% before kernel aborts — looks like a transient mem balloon during packing.
Sam: Repro seems specific to sparse packing (very small + very large contexts in same batch). When we force fixed-size batches the issue doesn't appear.
Jess: Temporary mitigation applied: scaled pool-east-1 nodes to lower density (fewer concurrent containers per GPU) and enabled fallback routing to an older quantized model for affected customers. Rolling now, will monitor. :thumbsup:
Mike: For repro I'll spin a dev container with the exact payload and runtime flags: `--packing=dynamic --kv-prefetch=true`. Can someone paste the prod runtime flags?
Sam: Prod flags: `--kv-prefetch=true --packing=dynamic --max_tokens=2048 --kv-prefetch-window=32`.
Tara: Next steps: collect full coredump and kernel dump from one of the restarted workers, gather GPU SM/memory counters (nvidia-smi dmon), and capture the exact batching trace. @Mike please coordinate with infra to repro on a dev GPU and file a kernel-level bug if we can reproduce. I'll open INC-2026 and attach the logs.
ops-bot: INC-2026 updated: triage notes added. Stakeholders: @Sam @Jess @Mike @Tara.
notes: Thread focused on hosted inference 503s caused by upstream worker crashes during sparse/packed batching edge-case. Short-term mitigation: scale pool density + fallback to quantized model. Action items: repro on dev GPU, collect coredump/kernel logs, add kernel bug if repro.
